tools.name: agent_bridge_discover
tools.title: Discover external coding agents
tools.description: Detect locally installed Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Hermes, Aider, and configured coding-agent CLIs.

tools.name: agent_bridge_help
tools.title: Inspect coding-agent CLI
tools.description: Read the installed command help for an external coding-agent bridge before delegating.

tools.name: agent_bridge_run
tools.title: Delegate to external coding agent
tools.description: Run an installed Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Hermes, Aider, or configured agent against the current workspace. Can wait or return a persistent process.

tools.name: external_agent_run
tools.title: Run arbitrary external agent
tools.description: Execute any configured or ad-hoc coding-agent command with placeholder arguments such as {prompt}, {cwd}, and {workspace}.

tools.name: archive_create
tools.title: Create archive
tools.description: Create tar.gz, tar.zst, tar, or zip archives from arbitrary host paths.

tools.name: archive_extract
tools.title: Extract archive
tools.description: Extract zip, tar.gz, tar.zst, tar, and common compressed archives.

tools.name: archive_list
tools.title: List archive contents
tools.description: List the files inside a zip or tar archive without extracting it.

tools.name: checksum_verify
tools.title: Verify file checksum
tools.description: Compute a file's hash and compare it against an expected digest, returning a match/mismatch verdict instead of leaving the comparison to the model.

tools.name: file_hash
tools.title: Hash file
tools.description: Calculate SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, or MD5 for a file without loading it all into model context.

tools.name: automation_create
tools.title: Create automation
tools.description: Schedule a recurring or one-time autonomous agent prompt, tool call, or unrestricted shell command. Schedules accept cron, ISO timestamps, or strings like every 15m.

tools.name: automation_delete
tools.title: Delete automation
tools.description: Permanently remove a scheduled automation.

tools.name: automation_list
tools.title: List automations
tools.description: List scheduled agent, tool, and shell automations with next/last run state.

tools.name: automation_pause
tools.title: Pause automation
tools.description: Disable an automation without deleting it.

tools.name: automation_resume
tools.title: Resume automation
tools.description: Enable an automation and compute its next run.

tools.name: automation_run_now
tools.title: Run automation now
tools.description: Immediately execute an automation regardless of its next scheduled time.

tools.name: automation_update
tools.title: Update automation
tools.description: Edit an automation schedule, action, name, metadata, or enabled state.

tools.name: browser_accessibility
tools.title: Browser accessibility tree
tools.description: Return the Chrome accessibility tree for semantic page understanding.

tools.name: browser_act
tools.title: Act on a page element
tools.description: Click, fill, select, check or press a key on an element by its ref from browser_extract. Waits for the page to settle and returns the new URL. Refuses to click purchase-style buttons ("Place order", "Pay now") unless the person confirms; refuses to type into password fields (use browser_login).

tools.name: browser_choose
tools.title: Let the person choose from the page
tools.description: Extract the options on the current page, show them to the person as a picker and return what they chose. With open:true the chosen option is opened. Use this when a decision is theirs: which restaurant, product, flight or result.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.title: Click browser element
tools.description: Click a CSS selector or page coordinate through the Chrome input pipeline.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.title: Close browser
tools.description: Terminate a MaskShift browser instance and its CDP connections.

tools.name: browser_close_tab
tools.title: Close browser tab
tools.description: Close one browser page target.

tools.name: browser_console
tools.title: Read browser console
tools.description: Read recent console messages, exceptions, and browser log entries from the page.

tools.name: browser_discover
tools.title: Discover browser
tools.description: Detect an installed Chromium, Chrome, or Edge executable for dependency-free CDP automation.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate browser JavaScript
tools.description: Execute arbitrary JavaScript in the active page and return a serializable value.

tools.name: browser_extract
tools.title: Extract page options
tools.description: Describe the current page as selectable options (restaurants, products, results), forms, blockers (login wall, CAPTCHA, cookie notice) and actions, each with a short ref such as e12 for browser_act. Far smaller than the raw page; prefer it to browser_snapshot for web tasks.

tools.name: browser_handoff
tools.title: Hand the browser to the person
tools.description: Ask the person to do something in the live browser view that you should not (solve a CAPTCHA, approve a bank prompt, enter payment details) and wait until they say they are done.

tools.name: browser_instances
tools.title: List browser instances
tools.description: List browser processes launched by MaskShift.

tools.name: browser_launch
tools.title: Launch browser
tools.description: Launch a persistent-profile Chromium browser with DevTools automation. Headless by default; visible mode supports interactive logins.

tools.name: browser_login
tools.title: Sign in through the terminal
tools.description: Sign in to the site open in the browser. The person is asked for their username, password and any verification code in the terminal; the values are typed into the page directly and never shown to you. CAPTCHAs are handed to the person in the live browser view. Returns only the outcome.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.title: Navigate browser
tools.description: Navigate a browser tab and wait for the document to load.

tools.name: browser_network
tools.title: Read browser network trace
tools.description: Read recent Chrome DevTools Network events for the page.

tools.name: browser_new_tab
tools.title: Open browser tab
tools.description: Create a new browser tab at a URL.

tools.name: browser_print_pdf
tools.title: Print page to PDF
tools.description: Render the current browser page to a PDF artifact using Chrome print layout.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.title: Capture browser screenshot
tools.description: Capture a viewport or full-page screenshot to a workspace artifact file.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.title: Read browser page
tools.description: Return page title, URL, visible text, and a selector map of interactive elements.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.title: List browser tabs
tools.description: List all page targets in a browser instance.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.title: Type in browser
tools.description: Focus an optional CSS selector, type text, and optionally submit with Enter.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.title: Wait for browser element
tools.description: Wait for a CSS selector to become visible, hidden, attached, or detached.

tools.name: lsp_code_actions
tools.title: Language-server refactors and quick fixes
tools.description: List the refactors and quick fixes the language server offers at a position or range (fix this error, extract a function, add a missing import…) and optionally apply one by index, by title, or the preferred one. Prefer this over hand-editing for mechanical refactors.

tools.name: lsp_definition
tools.title: Go to definition
tools.description: Resolve the definition location for a symbol at a source position.

tools.name: lsp_diagnostics
tools.title: Language diagnostics
tools.description: Return language-server errors, warnings, hints, and related information for a file.

tools.name: lsp_discover
tools.title: Discover language servers
tools.description: Detect installed language servers for TypeScript, Python, C/C++, Rust, Go, Java, Ruby, Lua, JSON, HTML, CSS, and YAML.

tools.name: lsp_format
tools.title: Language-aware format
tools.description: Ask the language server to format a document and optionally apply the edits.

tools.name: lsp_hover
tools.title: LSP hover
tools.description: Get type, signature, and documentation information at a 1-based source position.

tools.name: lsp_organize_imports
tools.title: Organize imports
tools.description: Sort and prune a file's imports with the language server.

tools.name: lsp_references
tools.title: Find semantic references
tools.description: Find language-aware references for a symbol at a source position.

tools.name: lsp_rename
tools.title: Semantic rename
tools.description: Compute and optionally apply a workspace-wide language-aware symbol rename.

tools.name: lsp_status
tools.title: Language server status
tools.description: List active workspace language server processes and capabilities.

tools.name: lsp_stop
tools.title: Stop language servers
tools.description: Stop one or all lazy language server processes for the workspace.

tools.name: lsp_symbols
tools.title: Document symbols
tools.description: Return language-server document symbols and hierarchy for a source file.

tools.name: container_build
tools.title: Build container image
tools.description: Build a Docker/Podman image from a Dockerfile or Containerfile with build args and tags.

tools.name: container_compose
tools.title: Run Compose
tools.description: Run Docker Compose or Podman Compose actions such as up, down, build, logs, ps, and config.

tools.name: container_engine
tools.title: Inspect container engine
tools.description: Detect Docker or Podman and return version and runtime information.

tools.name: container_exec
tools.title: Execute in container
tools.description: Execute a command in an existing Docker/Podman container.

tools.name: container_list
tools.title: List containers
tools.description: List running or stopped Docker/Podman containers as structured records.

tools.name: container_logs
tools.title: Read container logs
tools.description: Read recent container logs with timestamps, tail, and since controls.

tools.name: container_run
tools.title: Run container
tools.description: Run any Docker/Podman image with ports, volumes, environment, network, privilege, and detach controls.

tools.name: container_stop
tools.title: Stop or remove container
tools.description: Stop, kill, restart, pause, unpause, or remove a container.

tools.name: kubernetes_exec
tools.title: Run kubectl
tools.description: Execute any kubectl operation with a structured argument list and optional context, namespace, and kubeconfig.

tools.name: database_cli
tools.title: Run database CLI
tools.description: Execute a command through psql, mysql, redis-cli, mongosh, duckdb, or another installed database client.

tools.name: sqlite_query
tools.title: Query SQLite database
tools.description: Open any SQLite database directly through Node native SQLite, execute parameterized SQL, and return structured rows. Write statements are allowed.

tools.name: sqlite_schema
tools.title: Inspect SQLite schema
tools.description: Return tables, views, indexes, triggers, and CREATE statements from a SQLite database.

tools.name: doc_read
tools.title: Read a document (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, …)
tools.description: Read the text of a document with no external tools: PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx, sheets rendered as tables), PowerPoint (.pptx, with speaker notes), OpenDocument (.odt/.ods/.odp), EPUB, RTF and HTML. Use this instead of fs_read for any non-plain-text document. Legacy binary .doc/.xls/.ppt must be re-saved in the modern format first.

tools.name: image_read
tools.title: Read an image (OCR + description)
tools.description: Read an image file: extract any visible text with OCR, and — if a local vision model is available — generate a natural-language description or answer a question about it. Works even when the active chat model has no native vision support, because the description is produced out of band and returned as plain text.

tools.name: notebook_edit
tools.title: Edit Jupyter notebook cell
tools.description: Replace, insert, or delete one cell in a Jupyter (.ipynb) notebook by index. Replacing or inserting a code cell clears its stale outputs and execution count.

tools.name: notebook_read
tools.title: Read Jupyter notebook
tools.description: Read a Jupyter (.ipynb) notebook and return each cell's index, type, source, and a bounded summary of its outputs.

tools.name: pdf_read
tools.title: Extract PDF text
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF with a built-in parser (no external tools needed), with an optional page range. If the PDF is a scan with no text layer, falls back to rendering pages and running OCR when poppler-utils and tesseract are installed; also falls back to pdftotext if the built-in parser cannot read the file.

tools.name: chmod_set
tools.title: Change file permissions
tools.description: Change a path's POSIX mode (chmod) and optionally its owner/group (chown), reporting the mode before and after.

tools.name: file_diff
tools.title: Diff two files or directories
tools.description: Show a unified diff between two arbitrary paths (files or directories), independent of Git — for comparing anything on disk, not just a repo working tree.

tools.name: fs_apply_patch
tools.title: Apply unified diff
tools.description: Apply a unified diff using git apply. The patch can update multiple files and is checked before application.

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.title: Delete path
tools.description: Delete a file or directory recursively. Autonomous mode executes immediately without an approval prompt.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.title: List files and directories
tools.description: List a directory tree with file sizes and types. Paths may be workspace-relative or absolute in autonomous mode.

tools.name: fs_mkdir
tools.title: Create directory
tools.description: Create a directory and missing parent directories.

tools.name: fs_move
tools.title: Move or rename path
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory, optionally replacing the destination.

tools.name: fs_patch
tools.title: Apply exact text edits
tools.description: Apply one or more oldText/newText replacements to a file atomically. Minor whitespace or indentation differences are tolerated; text that is missing or ambiguous fails with the closest region shown, unless replaceAll is requested.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.title: Read text file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file with optional 1-based line range and hard output bounds.

tools.name: fs_read_binary
tools.title: Read binary file
tools.description: Read a bounded binary file as base64 with MIME-relevant metadata.

tools.name: fs_replace_lines
tools.title: Replace a range of lines
tools.description: Replace lines startLine..endLine (1-based, inclusive, as shown by fs_read) with new text. Pass expect (the first old line) to refuse the edit if the file has moved. Use an empty newText to delete lines, or endLine = startLine - 1 style ranges via fs_patch to insert.

tools.name: fs_stat
tools.title: Inspect path metadata
tools.description: Return file type, size, timestamps, mode, target and hash metadata.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.title: Write file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file atomically. Parent directories are created automatically.

tools.name: symbol_read
tools.title: Read a function, class or method
tools.description: Return one definition (function, class, method as Class.method) with its line range, without reading the whole file. With no symbol, list the definitions in the file.

tools.name: symbol_replace
tools.title: Replace a whole function, class or method
tools.description: Replace one definition by name with new source. You supply only the new text; the old text is located for you, so it never has to be reproduced exactly. Use Class.method for methods.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.title: Count lines, words, and bytes
tools.description: Report line, word, and byte counts for one or more text files (like wc) without spending context on their contents — use before deciding whether to read a file in full.

tools.name: fleet_ask
tools.title: Ask a fleet member
tools.description: Give one member a task or question and wait for its reply. Its inbox is delivered with it. Any [[send]] messages it writes are queued for the teammates it addresses (use fleet_relay to have them acted on).

tools.name: fleet_harnesses
tools.title: List fleet harnesses
tools.description: List the agent harnesses a fleet member can run on (claude, codex, opencode, hermes, copilot, aider, any configured custom bridge, or maskshift (the built-in engine)) and whether each is installed.

tools.name: fleet_list
tools.title: List fleet members
tools.description: List the fleet members with their harness, role, status, unread mail and last reply. Pass name for one member's full history.

tools.name: fleet_messages
tools.title: Read fleet conversation
tools.description: Read the recent messages passed between fleet members (optionally just those to or from one member).

tools.name: fleet_relay
tools.title: Run the fleet on a task
tools.description: Hand a task to the fleet and let its members work it out together: the lead gets the task, members message each other with [[send]] blocks, and rounds continue until someone writes [[done]], everyone falls quiet, or the round/time limit is reached. Returns the outcome and a per-turn trace.

tools.name: fleet_send
tools.title: Message a fleet member
tools.description: Queue a message from one member (or you) to another, or to="*" for everyone, without running anyone yet. It is delivered the next time the recipient takes a turn.

tools.name: fleet_spawn
tools.title: Add an agent to the fleet
tools.description: Create a persistent, named fleet member backed by claude, codex, opencode, hermes, copilot, aider, any configured custom bridge, or maskshift (the built-in engine). Several members may share a harness. Members keep their history and inbox between turns and can message each other. Use isolated=true to give an editing member its own Git worktree.

tools.name: fleet_stop
tools.title: Stop or remove a fleet member
tools.description: Cancel a member's current turn, optionally removing it from the fleet. With no name, cancels every member and running relay.

tools.name: fleet_suggest
tools.title: Which harness suits this task
tools.description: Rank the installed agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, …) for a task by how each has actually done on similar tasks before, with the evidence behind the ranking.

tools.name: git_branch
tools.title: Manage Git branches
tools.description: List, create, switch, rename, or delete branches. MaskShift runs these directly without permission prompts.

tools.name: git_checkpoint_create
tools.title: Create reversible checkpoint
tools.description: Snapshot tracked and untracked workspace changes so an agent run can be rolled back without interrupting normal Git history.

tools.name: git_checkpoint_list
tools.title: List checkpoints
tools.description: List reversible MaskShift workspace checkpoints.

tools.name: git_checkpoint_restore
tools.title: Restore checkpoint
tools.description: Restore a prior MaskShift checkpoint. This is destructive to current workspace changes.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.title: Create Git commit
tools.description: Stage selected or all changes and create a commit. Optional amend and no-verify modes are supported.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.title: Git diff
tools.description: Show working-tree, staged, commit-range, or selected-file diffs with configurable context and output bounds.

tools.name: git_log
tools.title: Git history
tools.description: Read compact commit history, optionally for a branch, range, author, grep expression, or path.

tools.name: git_show
tools.title: Show Git object
tools.description: Show a commit, tag, tree, or file at a revision.

tools.name: git_status
tools.title: Git status
tools.description: Inspect branch, upstream, staged, modified, deleted, renamed, conflicted, and untracked files.

tools.name: git_worktree_create
tools.title: Create isolated worktree
tools.description: Create a branch-backed Git worktree for isolated subagent or experimental work.

tools.name: credentials_forget
tools.title: Forget a saved sign-in
tools.description: Remove the remembered sign-in for a site (from memory and the keychain).

tools.name: credentials_list
tools.title: List saved sign-ins
tools.description: List which sites have a sign-in remembered, and where (this session or the system keychain). Never returns passwords or usernames.

tools.name: user_ask
tools.title: Ask the person a question
tools.description: Ask the person for a short piece of free text (a delivery address, a date, a preference) and return it. Never use it for passwords or codes; browser_login handles those.

tools.name: user_choose
tools.title: Ask the person to choose
tools.description: Show a short list of options and return the person's choice. Use it instead of guessing when a decision belongs to them.

tools.name: user_confirm
tools.title: Ask the person to confirm
tools.description: Ask a yes/no question before something irreversible, such as paying or sending, and return the answer. Include the facts they need to decide (item, total, address).

tools.name: learn_forget
tools.title: Forget a lesson or preference
tools.description: Remove one learned lesson or preference by id (from learn_status). Use it when something MaskShift learned is wrong or no longer applies.

tools.name: learn_status
tools.title: What MaskShift has learned
tools.description: Show what MaskShift has learned from its own runs on this machine: lessons from earlier runs, preferences noticed from your messages, how each model and harness has done on which kinds of task, workflows it could turn into skills, and how well context was used.

tools.name: router_explain
tools.title: Why would this task go to that model or agent
tools.description: Show how MaskShift would route a task: the models and the installed agent harnesses ranked by how they have actually done on similar tasks (success rate, cost), and how much evidence is behind each.

tools.name: skill_mine
tools.title: Find workflows worth saving as skills
tools.description: Look through recent runs for sequences of steps repeated across several runs that mostly went well, and draft a skill for each. Nothing is installed until skill_mine_accept.

tools.name: skill_mine_accept
tools.title: Accept or dismiss a mined skill
tools.description: Install a skill drafted by skill_mine (by name or id), or dismiss it so it is not suggested again.

tools.name: mcp_add
tools.title: Add arbitrary MCP server
tools.description: Add any stdio or HTTP MCP server definition, including command, arguments, environment, URL, headers, and lazy loading settings.

tools.name: mcp_call
tools.title: Call MCP tool by qualified name
tools.description: Invoke a connected MCP tool directly. Prefer activating its qualified tool so the model can call it natively on later turns.

tools.name: mcp_connect
tools.title: Connect MCP server
tools.description: Lazily start or connect an MCP server, negotiate modern or legacy protocol, and discover its tools.

tools.name: mcp_disconnect
tools.title: Disconnect MCP server
tools.description: Close a workspace-scoped MCP connection and unload its tool schemas.

tools.name: mcp_list
tools.title: List MCP servers
tools.description: List curated, imported, project, and configured MCP servers with live connection status and tool counts.

tools.name: mcp_prompts
tools.title: List MCP prompts
tools.description: List prompt templates provided by an MCP server.

tools.name: mcp_registry_install
tools.title: Install MCP Registry server
tools.description: Resolve a server from the official registry and add its remote or package transport to MaskShift configuration.

tools.name: mcp_registry_search
tools.title: Search official MCP Registry
tools.description: Search the live official MCP Registry instead of relying on a stale built-in server list.

tools.name: mcp_resource_read
tools.title: Read MCP resource
tools.description: Read a URI exposed by an MCP server.

tools.name: mcp_resources
tools.title: List MCP resources
tools.description: Connect to a server and list its MCP resources.

tools.name: mcp_search
tools.title: Search MCP capabilities
tools.description: Search discovered MCP servers and tools already known to MaskShift. Servers remain lazy until connected.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.title: Delete persistent memory
tools.description: Delete a memory by ID.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.title: List persistent memories
tools.description: List memories ordered by effective importance: raw importance blended with a recency decay so stale, untouched memories sink without being deleted.

tools.name: memory_optimize
tools.title: Optimize persistent memory
tools.description: Find duplicate-title memories to merge and stale, low-importance, never-accessed memories to prune. Defaults to a dry run that only reports candidates; set dryRun to false to apply the merge and prune.

tools.name: memory_save
tools.title: Save persistent memory
tools.description: Save a durable project or global fact, architectural decision, convention, result, or reusable lesson. Automatically merges into an existing memory with the same title in the same scope instead of creating a duplicate, unless dedupe is set to false.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.title: Search persistent memory
tools.description: Search project and global long-term memory, ranked by a blend of text relevance, importance, and recency (older, untouched memories decay in rank without being deleted).

tools.name: agent_cancel
tools.title: Cancel agent run
tools.description: Cancel a running subagent or other active MaskShift run.

tools.name: agent_dag_execute
tools.title: Execute DAG with subagents
tools.description: Execute the current dependency DAG in bounded parallel waves. Edit nodes default to isolated Git worktrees; failed dependencies block downstream work.

tools.name: agent_delegate
tools.title: Delegate to subagent
tools.description: Run a focused subagent with its own session and capability context. Optionally give it a named persona (see agent_persona_list) to frame its system prompt, and optionally isolate editing in a Git worktree and branch.

tools.name: agent_parallel
tools.title: Run parallel subagents
tools.description: Delegate multiple independent research, review, test, or implementation tasks concurrently and aggregate their final results. Each task may set its own persona.

tools.name: agent_persona_list
tools.title: List subagent personas
tools.description: List named personas (bundled and project-defined) that can be passed as agent_delegate's persona argument to frame a subagent's system prompt for a specific role, such as reviewing code or resolving a build failure.

tools.name: agent_route
tools.title: Route task to agent
tools.description: Recommend an available external coding-agent bridge or internal subagent based on the task profile.

tools.name: agent_run_status
tools.title: Inspect agent runs
tools.description: Inspect active and recent agent runs, including parent/subagent relationships.

tools.name: capability_activate
tools.title: Activate tools, skills, or MCP
tools.description: Load selected capabilities into the current model context. Local tools add schemas, skills add instructions, and MCP servers connect lazily and expose their tools.

tools.name: capability_search
tools.title: Search all capabilities
tools.description: Search local tools, reusable skills, imported MCP servers, and discovered MCP tools. Use this whenever the current tool set is insufficient.

tools.name: capability_state
tools.title: Inspect active capabilities
tools.description: Show the exact tools, skills, and MCP servers currently loaded for this run.

tools.name: model_calibrate
tools.title: Measure a model
tools.description: Run short probes (tool calling, a precise edit, planning, long-context recall) against a model and store the scores, so the harness sizes its help to what the model can actually do. Costs a few thousand tokens.

tools.name: model_profile
tools.title: Show how much help a model gets
tools.description: Show a model's scaffolding level (0 = leave it alone, 3 = carry it), why it was chosen, the knobs that level sets, and any stored calibration scores or observed track record.

tools.name: model_route
tools.title: Route task to model
tools.description: Rank configured models for a task using language/domain fit and prior MaskShift outcomes.

tools.name: plan_dag_update
tools.title: Create executable DAG plan
tools.description: Create a dependency-aware execution plan whose ready nodes can run concurrently and whose dependent nodes receive predecessor results.

tools.name: plan_get
tools.title: Read execution plan
tools.description: Return the current run plan and progress.

tools.name: plan_update
tools.title: Update execution plan
tools.description: Create or update the run plan with concise steps and statuses. Use it for multi-step work and keep it synchronized with actual progress.

tools.name: plugin_activate
tools.title: Activate plugin
tools.description: Load a plugin directly into the MaskShift process with full tool registration access.

tools.name: plugin_deactivate
tools.title: Deactivate plugin
tools.description: Run a plugin cleanup hook and remove its registered tools.

tools.name: plugin_install
tools.title: Install plugin
tools.description: Install a plugin from a local directory, Git repository, or npm package and activate it.

tools.name: plugin_list
tools.title: List MaskShift plugins
tools.description: List discovered runtime plugins, their status, tools, and skill directories.

tools.name: plugin_reload
tools.title: Hot reload plugin
tools.description: Deactivate and re-import one plugin, or every discovered plugin, without restarting MaskShift.

tools.name: plugin_scaffold
tools.title: Create plugin
tools.description: Generate and activate a complete single-tool MaskShift plugin scaffold.

tools.name: plugin_scan
tools.title: Scan plugins
tools.description: Rescan user and workspace plugin directories and activate newly discovered plugins.

tools.name: change_impact
tools.title: Analyze change impact
tools.description: Walk reverse imports and call relationships before an edit to identify affected symbols, modules, and likely tests.

tools.name: code_graph_build
tools.title: Build code knowledge graph
tools.description: Build a persistent repository graph of files, symbols, imports, containment, and likely calls for dependency-aware navigation.

tools.name: code_graph_query
tools.title: Query code knowledge graph
tools.description: Find files and symbols in the persistent code graph, including incoming and outgoing relationship counts.

tools.name: context_plan_explain
tools.title: Explain context selection
tools.description: Build a dry context plan and report budgets, selected source files, retrieval reasons, and excluded stale memories.

tools.name: project_index_status
tools.title: Repository index status
tools.description: Show local indexed file, chunk, character, and freshness statistics.

tools.name: project_inspect
tools.title: Inspect project
tools.description: Summarize repository shape, dominant languages, build manifests, instructions, Git state, and local index health.

tools.name: project_instructions
tools.title: Load hierarchical instructions
tools.description: Load AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, MASKSHIFT.md, Copilot instructions, and other configured context files from repository root through the working directory.

tools.name: project_read_manifest
tools.title: Read project manifest
tools.description: Read and optionally parse a package/build manifest such as package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod, or CMakeLists.txt.

tools.name: project_tree
